## Three ways Studio pays for itself

95%+accuracy customers see at deployment

### Stop revenue leaks

Catch what doesn't match before you pay for it. Agents check every invoice against its contract and every claim against its policy, not a sample.

85%less time on the month-end close

### Save time

Automate the reading, checking, and re-keying up to the point where judgment matters. Your team handles the exceptions so you stay in control.

3-monthaverage payback window

### Catch problems early

Expired certificates, weight mismatches, and missing records get flagged before the audit, the port hold, or the payment. Your team fixes them while it's still cheap.

Proof
